verses.text: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanto t'a scha'anhil satcha'anh.
Alek wach' lolonel t'ay masanil ex yángel. Alek wach' lolonel masanil ex soldado'al satcha'anh.
Ik'chajokab' cha'anh Jehová yuj k'u yet' k'e'en uj. Ik'chajokab' cha'anh yuj k'e'en nitk'anal te wach' yilji yok.
Ik'chajokab' cha'anh yuj satcha'anh, to cha'anh ay yet' pax yuj ha ha' ayek' t'a yib'anh satcha'anh chi'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tonhej ix yala' ix b'okan smasanil.
A' ix b'oankan masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yet'tal yik wach' ayek' ta' t'a masanil tiempo, ix yak'ankanoch t'a sleyal to malaj b'ak'inh ol k'exchajok.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um tik, nok' niwak nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' pax nok' ay t'a sjulal yich ha',
yet' lheb'lon, k'e'en sakb'at, k'e'en sakb'akom, k'ik'al asun yet' chakxuxum ik', k'anab'ajumokab' syutej sb'a t'a slolonel Jehová chi'.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel lum niwak witz t'a Jehová, lum tzalkixtak, te te' syak' sat, te' k'ute',
yet' nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi yet' pax nok' much.
Ex sreyal yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ex anima t'a junjun chonhab', ex yajal yet' ex tze b'o yaj heb' chonhab',
ex winak, ex ix, ex ichamtak anima yet' pax ex unin, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil.
Alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil yujto anhej te b'inajnak. Ha stzikikial ay masanto t'a yib'anh satcha'anh yet' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.
A' ix ak'an kipal a onh schonhab' onh tik. Kalek wach' lolonel t'ay a onh israel onh tik, a onhton te xajanab'il onh yuj. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
